Choose a shared basis for a record

Source: R/shared.R
select_shared.Rd

Returns the index of the basis with the lowest mean per-beat relative error on the given beats. A compressor transmits this index, of log2(C) bits.

Usage

select_shared(fit, X)

Arguments

fit

A bp_shared object.

X

A beat matrix.

Value

An integer index, with the errors in the attribute errors.

Examples

sim <- simulate_beats(H = 6, n = 50, p = 20, q = 3, seed = 3)
m <- lapply(sim$X, energy_moment, q = 5)
fit <- pool_shared(m, k = 2, C = 2, starts = 2, seed = 1)
select_shared(fit, sim$X[[1]])
#> [1] 2
#> attr(,"errors")
#> [1] 0.5584512 0.5101670
